description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog brands in an e-commerce web application. It includes a class implementing an endpoint interface, handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve catalog brand data from a repository, maps domain entities to DTOs, and returns a structured response.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog brands, handling route registration and response handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route for GET requests to 'api/catalog-brands' and associates it with the handler.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving catalog brands from the repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the response.
